help.text:
NAME:
   RITA - Look for evil needles in big haystacks

USAGE:
   rita [-d] command [command options]

COMMANDS:
   import         import zeek logs into a target database
   view           view <dataset name>
   delete         delete a dataset
   list           list available datasets
   validate       validate a configuration file
   zone-transfer  perform a zone transfer on the configured domain
   help, h        Shows a list of commands or help for one command

GLOBAL OPTIONS:
   --debug, -d  Run in debug mode (default: false)
   --help, -h   show help

--database.help: target database; database name should start with a lowercase letter, should contain only alphanumeric and underscores, and not end with an underscore

--limit.help: limit the number of results to display

--non-interactive.help: does not prompt for confirmation of deletion

--rebuild.help: destroys existing database and imports given files

--rolling.help: indicates rolling import, which builds on and removes data to maintain a fixed length of time
